source_interface_gaps.interpretation: XZ alignment supports candidate transverse hinge axes; differing Y spans need shaft, spacer, clearance and attachment evidence. No whole pantograph recentering or scaling is applied.

old_comparison.labels_are_not_equivalent: Old E is lower-arm tip; new E is head rocker/suspension axis. New B is lower-arm tip. Never map by letter alone.

lower_mass_kg.note: Whole lower assembly lumped at arm midpoint; not inferred from mesh volume.

upper_mass_kg.note: Upper beam and fork lumped at centerline midpoint.

head_carriage_mass_kg.note: Stationary portion of assumed head guide assembly.

head_float_mass_kg.note: Collector, carbon strips, carriers and assumed floating pins/yokes.

old_unmodeled: Physical E-axis motion relative to lower arm; E->U carrier is provisionally rigid with lower arm.
Both slender adjustable rods: 3D ball centers, hinge attachment ownership and mechanical closure.
Air bellows effective area, pressure chamber, hysteresis, force path, air circuit and deformation.
B32 black barrel linkage, bore, stroke, piston side, seals, friction and function.
Rigid head linkage leveling/synchronization; no ideal parallelogram or algebraic fold relation is imposed.
Actual head guide internals and which guide pieces translate; present split is a declared equivalent.
Wire tension, sag, transverse dynamics, droppers and speed-dependent catenary effects; wire is fixed here.
Carbon wear, elasticity, arcing, electric current and copper braid flexibility.
Physical masses, inertia tensors, damping, springs and true motion stops; all dynamics are uncalibrated.
Arm-roof, link-link and cover collisions; only collector/wire and numerical joint stops are solved.

hypotheses.H_BASE_FIXED: New base/insulators fixed to assembly roof; no compliance calibrated.
hypotheses.H_LOWER_BUSHINGS_FIXED: A/B bushings rotate with lower arm, rather than shaft-fixed bushings.
hypotheses.H_UPPER_COMPONENT_RIGID: Upper main/fork/H eyes form one rigid CAD component.
hypotheses.H_ELBOW_FIXED_TO_UPPER: B and C elbow plates are fixed to upper main at U. U is not an independent hinge in this candidate.
hypotheses.H_G_ON_LOWER: G bracket is rigidly attached to lower arm.
hypotheses.H_LOWER_TIE_LOCKED: C-D adjustment is locked; rigid tie with transverse pin ends.
hypotheses.H_UPPER_TIE_RIGID: F-G shaft and eyes form a rigid tie with transverse pin ends.
hypotheses.H_ROCKER_FOLLOWS_H: Single E/F/H rocker hinges to upper arm at H; E suspension is left unmodeled.
hypotheses.H_PLANAR_AXES: All candidate linkage axes parallel to world Y; lateral bearing stack, spherical axes and tolerances unverified.

candidate_topology.mass_policy: Explicit unit-test masses and analytic envelope inertias only; not old calibrated masses or mesh-density physical estimates.
candidate_topology.force_ports: Research root torque only; no prescribed qpos trajectory, no pneumatic actuation or collector force.

evidence: Upper main U circle 2A21, B plate 2A34/2781 and C plate 2A35/278B are nested in source INSERT 2B30.
Their outer/seat arcs are concentric at U; C seat R15 equals U circle R15, B outline R18.999689.
The moving head rocker 2A38 is nested in the same 2B30, so common INSERT cannot imply fixed rigidity.
H_ELBOW_FIXED_TO_UPPER.remaining: Need keyed/welded/fastened connection or motion evidence distinguishing an independent U hinge.

H_G_ON_LOWER.source_parent: 2B36 is a sibling of lower arm 2B2B; it is not nested in the lower-arm INSERT.
H_G_ON_LOWER.remaining: Curved seat against B boss supports location, but rotation lock and lateral spacer/shaft stack are unknown.

evidence: E/F/H are the three circles 2A1A/2A1B/2A1C in the same rocker definition under 2A38.
Rocker H and upper H are concentric native R4.1 circles.
Rocker E matches separate head suspension circle 28E3 in 2B21.
H_ROCKER_FOLLOWS_H.remaining: Rocker is one source part, but actual bearing type and fixing to head shaft remain unverified.
